1. Prices are per unit in the stated currency, excluding VAT and local taxes unless stated.
2. Lead times are estimates from date of purchase order and are subject to supplier confirmation.
3. Delivery per the stated Incoterms (ICC Incoterms 2020).
4. Orders are subject to export-control and sanctions screening of the end user and destination.
5. Specifications not confirmed by the customer (marked TBC) must be confirmed before order.
6. Cancellation of confirmed orders may incur supplier charges.
